A skill is a package of structured files that teaches an AI coding agent how to work with a specific tool or framework. The skill below was generated by Great Docs from this project's documentation. Install it in your agent and it will be able to run commands, edit configuration, write content, and troubleshoot problems without step-by-step guidance from you.

```{=html}
<div class="gd-skills-install">
  <button class="gd-skills-install-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="gd-skills-install-body">
    <span class="gd-skills-install-icon">&#9654;</span>    Install this skill
  </button>
  <div class="gd-skills-install-body" id="gd-skills-install-body">
    <div class="gd-skills-install-inner">
      <div class="gd-skills-install-pad">
```

**Any agent** --- install with [npx](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):

```{=html}
<div class="sourceCode"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy" style="padding-bottom: 0;"><code>npx skills add <site-url></code></pre></div>
```

**Codex / OpenCode**

```{=html}
<div class="sourceCode"><pre class="sourceCode text code-with-copy" style="padding-bottom: 0;"><code>Tell the agent:<br>Fetch the skill file at &lt;site-url&gt;/skill.md and follow the instructions.</code></pre></div>
```

**Manual** --- download the skill file:

```{=html}
<div class="sourceCode"><pre class="sourceCode bash code-with-copy" style="padding-bottom: 0;"><code>curl -O &lt;site-url&gt;/skill.md</code></pre></div>
```

# Dash Mantine DataTable

## Installation

```bash
pip install dash-mantine-datatable
```

## API overview

### Component

Main generated Dash component.

- `DataTable`: Description

### Helper Builders

Dictionary factories for readable table configuration.

- `Column`: Description
- `ColumnGroup`: Description
- `SelectionConfig`: Description
- `PaginationConfig`: Description
- `RowExpansionConfig`: Description
